item.title: Brazilians take to the streets calling attention to a crisis of violence against women
item.description: In 2024, Brazil had 1,492 victims of femicide, the highest number registered since the femicide law came into effect. This represents four women killed every day for reasons linked to their gender.

item.title: Armenia and Azerbaijan: dialogue or performance?
item.description: Armenia and Azerbaijan, after the second Karabakh war, appear increasingly close to normalizing relations, but analysts and activists are not entirely convinced that the process will be transparent and inclusive.

item.title: Why cybersafety matters in the African Union–European Union partnership
item.description: Research shows that women are less likely to access the Internet than men and face higher exposure to harassment once they are online. These conditions limit participation and restrict leadership.
